title: HTTP Responses and Status Codes
learning_objectives: Read and write the status line, headers and body of a response
Know the common codes an API returns
Compare a hand-written table with http.HTTPStatus
entry_point: status_class(code); reason(code); build_response(status, body='', content_type='text/plain; charset=utf-8'); parse_response(raw)
hints: `status_class` can index a list with `code // 100 - 1` after checking the range.
Content-Length is `len(body.encode("utf-8"))`; for 204 the head is only the status line.
Status line: `version, code, phrase = line.split(" ", 2)` keeps spaces inside the phrase.

failure_feedback.advice: Map `code // 100` to the five classes and reject codes outside 100–599.
Fill `REASONS` with every code listed in the task.
Content-Length counts UTF-8 bytes, and Content-Type uses the given value.
204 responses have only the status line; reject a body.
Split the status line with `split(" ", 2)` and lowercase header names.
